Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the evidence from the WebSurfer, incorrectly conflating the Royal Australian Navy (RAN) with the Royal Navy. Despite the source stating it is “the oldest Christian chapel of the Royal Australian Navy,” the Planner concluded the naval branch was the Royal Navy and tied it to the British Armed Forces.
